items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I worked in Dupreez's place once when I first came to New York. I worked in his place at the Lafayette Theater

ctx.x: Well, you know, I worked in Dupreez's place once when I first came to New York. I worked in his place at the Lafayette Theater and doubled at the Cotton Club. I used to talk to him when I was seeing him but very seldom I seen him because Calloway's band was always on the road and always gone.
